text: A4.3.16 SECTION 16: Other information Provide information relevant to the preparation of the SDS in this section. This should incorporate other information that does not belong in sections 1 to 15 of the SDS, including information on preparation and revision of the SDS such as: (a) the date of preparation of the latest revision of the SDS. When revisions are made to an SDS, unless it has been indicated elsewhere, clearly indicate where the changes have been made to the previous version of the SDS. Suppliers should maintain an explanation of the changes and be willing to provide it upon request; (b) a key/legend to abbreviations and acronyms used in the SDS; and (c) key literature references and sources for data used to compile the SDS. NOTE: While references are not necessary in SDS’s, references may be included in this section if desired.
